instruction: Inspect hard-18_seed.dxf. At the start of the task, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-18_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'asymmetric engine mount bracket' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, RIB. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(220,0); OUTLINE (220,0)->(240,40); OUTLINE (240,40)->(210,125); OUTLINE (210,125)->(145,155); OUTLINE (145,155)->(80,135); OUTLINE (80,135)->(35,90); OUTLINE (35,90)->(0,0); RIB (35,90)->(220,0); RIB (80,135)->(145,0); RIB (145,155)->(210,0); RIB (0,0)->(145,155); CUTOUT (95,130)->(145,130); CUTOUT (95,120)->(145,120); CUTOUT (200,47)->(200,83); CUTOUT (210,47)->(210,83); CENTER (0,77.5)->(240,77.5); CENTER (120,0)->(120,155). Required circles: HOLE center (35,30) radius 8; HOLE center (190,30) radius 8; HOLE center (95,95) radius 12; HOLE center (165,105) radius 10; HOLE center (120,55) radius 6. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (95,125) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (145,125) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (205,83) radius 5 start 0 end 180; CUTOUT center (205,47) radius 5 start 180 end 0; OUTLINE center (35,90) radius 20 start 180 end 300; OUTLINE center (210,125) radius 24 start 300 end 60. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H18; ANNOTATION text ASYM ENGINE MOUNT. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
